        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run db:test

  all-green:
    name: All Jobs Successful
    needs: [lint, test, database-tests]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      - uses: re-actors/alls-green@release/v1
        with:
          jobs: lint,test,database-tests
